reviews.comment: Best professor I've had at TAMU, he's awesome and I'm sad that I can't take his Math 172 class in the fall. He's seriously the best professor though, he's funny, he learns peoples names, and he takes an effort in your work.

Dr. Manuel's a good professor and if you are a physics or math major you should thrive in this class. I am not, so the all free response exams where you would lose points for not including notation were tough.This will be a class you really have to lock in for but as far as 171 professors he's probably the best you'll find, nice and funny guy.

I had never taken calculus before this class so I was a bit worried. However, he is a great lecturer and is readily available to help when needed. He gave a huge extra credit bump after the second exam. There are proofs in this class, but he tells you which ones may be on the exam and how to do them. The homework is very helpful for practice too.

I loved this class. Manuel knows his stuff very well, and is very passionate about it. One of my favorite teachers. Tests are hardish, but it's supposed to be hard given the subject. Honestly, they could've been much harder in my opinion.

Probably the most "solid" professor you can get. He has a really clear way of speaking, and he's consistently entertaining through his stories and goofy jokes. He actually covers in lectures exactly what the corresponding homework is about and is very forgiving when it comes to late assignments, just as long as you've demonstrated basic effort.

He's kind of wacky but he prepares you to succeed! He records all of his lectures and posts them, attendance isn't mandatory, and the work follows the same schedule. His homework's are easy to follow and prepare you for the exam practice. The exam practice helps immensely with the exams,!

My Q-drop speaks nothing for how well Dr. Manuel taught this class. I was very sick throughout most of the semester but for what I did gather in Calc 2 (which is already hard) Dr. Manuel did an AMAZING job at explaining content, and was passionate and funny all at once. I absolutely loved this guy and hope I can take his class again!

Very nice and funny. Lectures are fun if you pay attention. If math is a difficult subject for you then I would suggest going to his office hours. Recitation helps a lot with understanding the material.

Manuel is awesome: his lectures are very interactive, digestible, and even silly. I *highly* recommend going to as many of his office hours as possible. He's very patient and knowledgeable, and he never makes you feel bad. The most weed-out thing about this class was the labs, which overall counted for very little. He's my favorite prof ever.

I enjoyed this class a lot! Very open to questions during class, all expectations are very well defined. Calc 2 is a hard class and this professor is very good at teaching it. Does sound a little like a muppet but thats not a bad thing imo.

Dr. Manuel is an amazing professor for this class. Cal 2 is already a hard class, but Dr. Manuel's depth of understanding made it a lot easier to understand. His lectures are funny and engaging, and he also walks through problems in class and answers questions well.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He's a super chill guy. Bro is super funny and makes jokes, sometimes sings in class, and is super good at explaining super complicated stuff. Loved his class and I actually enjoyed going to his lectures. Super easy to talk to him, he answers questions, and is genuinely enthusiastic to teach the class. Love his energy
Very helpful and clear lectures, good at answering questions in class, also helpful outside of class, an overall great guy, good prof for a hard class.
Take honors, best class I've ever taken in engineering for sure and I've taken a lot of classes. He makes sure you know your stuff

My experience was that he agreed to teach 251 which he has not taught for a long time and therefore really struggled to explain the concepts in a student friendly way.
Maybe he is better for 151 and 152, but not for 251.
Great prof for math 168. The syllabus is clear and there are no surprises about what is expected of the students. Great prof and has good TAs at office hours.

I took Professor Manuel for MATH 365 online during the summer and he was the best! Truly was helpful and did what he could to help you pass. While his tests were hard, he offered extra credit after the first test and was able to drop a few assignments in the end of the course. The textbook was needed as many of the homework problems were from it.

Fantastic lecturer, extremely organized, and very patient with answering questions.  The honors exams are HARD - all free response and heavy on proofs.  I spent a ton of time studying for this class but I thought it was totally worth it.  I've never learned more in a math class than in this class, even though it was my second time taking Calc 1.

He is a good professor but a tough grader. He will easily take points off for improper notation even if you did the work correctly, but I understand he is doing it for a good reason. Overall it is a tough class but he explains material well and all lectures are recorded for the ones who don't attend class.
Overall very willing to help. I had to drop the class because I suck at math but he was great. The exams are rough, very few questions and no multiple choice.

Please do NOT take Math 151 Honors. It will be the hardest class you take by far, and the professor does not help. His lectures drone on, he makes quippy jokes and he glosses over important facts because he expects you to know it all already. He grades extremely strict, and if you go to office hours or ask for help/clarification, expect sass.

If you have the opportunity not to take this class, don't. The only reason you would excel at this is if you're a math major. I made the mistake taking this class because I thought it would be easier than 151, and it is by far the most difficult class I've ever had. If you're anything other math or physics, don't even consider this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Took 151 honors, and the advisors lie they are REALLY different/harder, you have to know a ton of proofs that make up a portion of your exam. The professor is great and caring but sometimes too smart for me, if you don't care for ETAM and want to learn take this class. Additionally, all the tests are FRQ unlike regular which is mostly MCQ.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: (Honors) I personally struggled a lot with this class and I wouldn't recommend this class if you are unfamiliar with calculus like I was. I heard that it was "slightly harder" and that was a complete lie; the homework/lectures do not prepare you for the exams nearly enough. Prof. Manuel is a good professor but the class is extremely difficult.

For honors he adds proofs which you definitely have not done before in Calc, so its almost like an entirely different class. You need to study for the exams for sure. He curves the class up a little too at the end, for us he dropped the A threshold from 90 to 88.5, and in the past I heard he went as low as 88.

I took 151 honors and this class was really hard. Exams are 13 FRQs with 1 MCQ python question (because 151 does python labs...). The class was structured pretty much like 171, which is the math major version of the class. I had an 87 going into the final, clutched up (93 on final), ended the class with an A before he added a 1.5 point curve.

I took the honours section of Prof. Manuel's 151 course. BEWARE, IT IS HARD. The course work is much harder than the non-honours sections. The exams are pure free respose, and there is a proofs section that is exclusive to the honours block on every exam. That said, professor Manuel is an amazing teacher and person, and I highly recommend his class

This is for the MATH151 Honor's section; be ready to complete weekly homework and python lab assignments. Attendance is NOT mandatory and lecture/notes are all posted online. However, his in-person lectures are also super engaging and entertaining. The only part annoying part was learning proofs which regular 151 did not have to do.

DO NOT TAKE MATH 151 HONORS. This professor will make you learn all the proofs that 171 has to learn and this class is wildly different from the regular 151 sections. no one in my class ended with an A at the end of the semester and he only curved to make a 88.5 an A. Exams felt impossible to study for because it was never stuff from the notes

Go to lecture and listen for his jokes; they're there, they're quick, and they're funny. He is really good at explaining stuff and wants you to succeed. He also wants you to be thorough, so you will lose points for really little things but it makes you a better mathematician. His 151 honors class was so cool!!!

I took his honors Math 151 class, and it was extremely difficult. I had taken Calc BC in high school and got a 4 on both my scores, and this class was overwhelming challenging. I failed 1/2 of my exams but managed to get ~81% as my final grade with my final exam. He's an amazing lecturer, and a good person, but makes his class very difficult.
You can really teach yourself the material for Math 140, in my opinion. Class is encouraged with random poll everywhere. He's passionate about the material and will help if you ask for it.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: AWESOME LECTURES, had TONS of office hours, gave examples of coding assignments and homework during the lectures and office hours.  Made recordings and posted annotated notes of lectures.  Great English and made LOTS of memorable analogies and math jokes to help us remember content.  Exams were stressful, but he made the course more manageable.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Manuel is a solid choice for Calc 2. Though the class can be challenging, his lectures are clear and he's happy to clarify concepts. Consistent engagement with the textbook and office hours really pays off. unstuckstudy also proved helpful for supplemental practice.

Final exam totally screwed me over. He says final exam is only like 25 percent new material but thats not true its mostly the new material. Nothing from math learning center helped enough on exam bc every homework, quiz, math learning center review. All were like 10% hard. Then exam was 100% thry get exam questions from 2016 so use wayback machine.

Don't take if not engineering major. Your advisors will say this is easier than 172 but Its not. Group projects for coding and no one in my group helped me. Exams with stuff not on any homework, lecture, or quiz. They hide many past exams because they were running out of hard questions so use way back machine to see more past exams.

I took this class in Spring '24. Dr. Manuel is a great professor, and actually explains the conceptual aspects of the class. He's also pretty patient during office hours. That being said, Dr. Manuel's final was harder than the other profs. He also grades the FRQs hard. But he does offer extra credit if you do it. It got me from a B to an A.

My GOAT. I suffered a lot during the summer session while working & he was super accommodating. My grade doesn't reflect his teaching at all- I'm just a TERRIBLE test taker- but his lectures aren't bad. I watched old lectures with Amy Austin and Schrader in comparison: I prefer Amy Austin's note style but liked David Manuel's verbal explanations.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: if you have the opportunity to take Manuel please do! Calc 2 is known for being a difficult course and it is, but Professor Manuel is such an amazing professor! He was super accessible and explained tough concepts in a way that is actually understandable, so you don't just get stuck memorizing the processes. 11/10 would take again
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He's not a great lecturer but certainly not the worst. I have two gripes with him: 1) His final is way harder than other classes and... 2) it's pointless asking him questions. He rarely gives useful answers and half the time is just straight up rude in doing so. Luckily I had an awesome TA. Don't necessarily avoid him, but there are better profs.

Although Calc 2 can be challenging, Professor Manuel does a good job of breaking down each topic and explaining it to us. He is constantly updating the canvas including uploading lectures. He is also very accessible outside of class. Highly recommend for calc 2
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: I liked Professor Manuel so much for 151 that I purposely took him again for 152. Although both courses were very tough, I was able to get As in both thanks to his strong lectures and fantastic office hours. He's very hardworking and legitimately wants to help students, just make sure to take advantage of all resources that he is always suggesting.

He is a good lecturer I'll give him that, but he is incredibly sassy and rude. 
The most sadistic common exam was made by him, so you can imagine what his final was like. 
At the end he emailed us saying his averages were way lower than the other profs (shocker) and then proceeded to only curve bubble grades. How kind! (I'm seething)

Dr. Manuel was a very nice professor and would even explain topics repeatedly if needed so you understand them. He did record lectures. Prep assignments can help your semester grade. He did tend to explain topics conceptually before anything else. Be sure to do a lot of practice problems and practice applying the concept to problems.

I had professor Manuel for honors 151 and 152, and he is definitely one of the better professors I have had. He loves teaching and is happy to explain any concepts. He is very easily accessible outside of class with lots of office hours. He is a tough grader but adjusts grades very fairly to help students succeed. Highly recommend overall!

Great lecturer, answers questions and wants his students to succeed. His canvas modules are well organized and his grading is fair. Not a personal fan of the 'prep assignments' but he curved your grade up to 2% if you did all of them. Beware of the exams (lowest one dropped if you do well on final)

Math 152 is an extremely difficult course, but Dr. Manuel is an extremely engaging and entertaining lecturer. Great over email and in his office hours, and he may award extra points if you complete the prep assignments, gave me the boost I needed to get an A. I would take him over and over again for any math course

Outstanding lecturer, I had Manuel for both 152 and 151 and he is able to explain concepts concisely and clearly to all students. MATH 152 is an extremely rigorous class, but it was thanks to him that I left the class with a great understanding of Calculus. However, beware of the exams because they take up the majority of your grade in the class.

Professor Manuel is one of the best MATH 152 profs out there, as he teaches the course in an engaging and easy to understand manner. The only downside to his lectures is that he can go very fast, which makes it hard to understand. The class is heavily dependent on exams (80%), so the only way to succeed is to do good on the exams.

Professor is very good and the lectures are well organized. He drops a couple of grades at the end of the course and rounds up if you do all assignments. The only flaw is that he goes very fast through the notes which can be hard to understand at times.

Manuel is a great lecturer and easy to follow. He makes asking questions feel very welcoming and explains topics patiently. Left this class with a great understanding of Calc II. However, his tests make up a large portion of the class grade and are difficult because of the particular grading. Utilize office hours to ensure proper notation.

Great prof, fun dad jokes, talks formally/can be confusing. Just don't take honors unless you're ALREADY good at calc- less detailed notes, harder material, proofs, frq exams. I failed & am now w/ Cantu. First test got a 97 versus a 54... now I don't have to go to class lol. still recommend but know ur ability, others were fine. easy/mcq final

Prof Manuel is an amazing teacher and an even better standup-on-a-chair comedian when it comes to diverging series (You'll see if you take his class). I HIGHLY recommend him for 152. Even though his quizzes are a little challenging, you get used to them. His lectures are also extremely helpful for exams, so pay attention and you will make an A.

I had Manuel for 151, but for 152, it was a tad different. He is a great prof, truly cares, and is funny. Lectures were a bit lacking compared to some other profs for 152, but nonetheless, if you paid attention and did all the supplemental work, you should be fine. I did not take BC in high school, but I still managed to pass. Beware of exam 2!
Professor Manuels notes are not good. His lectures also are kind of confusing. He isnt the worst... but if you can take todd schrader.

Posts completed notes and recordings! Genuinely pretty funny and maintains a good relation with the student body. Good about both taking and answering questions. Even if you take a different MATH151 prof I'd HEAVILY recommend just going to his lectures instead. I never went to his office hours personally, but I heard good things there as well.

Dr. Manuel was a great professor. I took his honors 151 class and it's very heavy on proofs and answering questions in class. He's a picky grader on tests, but very accessible outside of class and will work to make sure his students succeed.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: If you didn't take AP Calculus in high school, be prepared to review some things on your own. With that being said, most of it will just be simple memorization rules, for application of the rules, he is a great lecturer and very funny and engaging.

Took Calc AB & BC in high school. 100% worth it to retake it in college. I had the foundation from 2 prior years of calculus, but it made me realize how much critical thinking and obscure algebra that was not used within the AP curriculum. Dr. Manuel organized his class extremely well, and is very fair and upright with his expectations.

If you did not take AP Calc in high school I would not recommend. He is very passionate and clearly knows what he is talking about, but his lectures are focused CONSEPTUALLY. He uses very little examples, and does a ton of explaining with words. Overall he is an intelligent man but I simply could not learn from his teaching style.

I took his class honors, which was much more difficult than the regular sections. Although his tests were hard, he was more than fair. He adjusted future exams and his grading scale after each exam to keep the course balanced. Enthusiastic guy and very patient.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Manuel's lectures were amazingly clear and concise. He taught everything thoroughly and was very easy to access outside of class during office hours and email.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Amazing professor. I took honors and it was my most difficult class, but I learned a lot. His tests were difficult, but he is aware of it and adjusts things accordingly to compensate it for it, such as making the final a breeze. Go to class, and you are pretty much guaranteed a B, but you will have to put in the effort for the A. Great lectures.

Totally awesome professor. He was funny in lectures (which you should attend), and super helpful in office hours. I would highly recommend taking him if you can. Your grade is almost all based on exams, so study well in advance for the exams. I have taken calc before so it wasn't too bad a class, but I still learned a lot by re-taking it.

He was good and lectures were ok. Beware he does take off points for not showing proof as well as the tests are all multiple choice which I wasn't used to. The homework is pretty easy and he drops lowest grades which is the only reason I got an 80. Overall I recommend him and he seems like a nice guy.

I really enjoyed Manuel's class and I'll be taking him again for 152. The class is easy if you took AP Calc, but if you haven't, it's taught like a review and would be difficult. His class was very upbeat and his office hours are always full. The lab wasn't difficult, but overwhelming for the first few weeks if you've never done python.

I have no negative things to say about Dr. Manuel. I took calculus AB before, so I felt more prepared for the class than I would have been, but if you have no prior calculus knowledge, the class might be difficult. It is a little fast paced. There are quizzes every week and python labs, and overall he provided a lot of resources to study with.

Nice/caring professor. I took the honors version of MATH-151 and got blindsided by the difficulty of proofs he expected students to know for exam. Gave a fair amount of free/easy points to help balance. He writes his own honors version exams

Professor Manuel is an amazing calc professor. Granted the exams are hard but if you do the practice questions from the online textbook you should feel good about it. Overall awesome guy and super willing to hear you out if you made a mistake or anything of that sort with a misplaced assignment or a messed-up turn in.

A fantastic professor for 151. Having minimum prior calculus knowledge, he was able to explain most topics very well and easy for me to understand. Make sure to stay on top of online HW, and study for quizzes (most are very easy). Also, the python labs are not too difficult coming from someone with no prior coding knowledge. I 100% recommend.

Manuel is very well-rounded! He does a great job of explaining the material during lectures and explaining the "why" of what we're doing. He answers tons of questions in lecture too. He does well at explaining the process, which is very helpful. Know your Python! They will teach it to you, but some prior knowledge would definitely help.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment:
Amazing Professor. Gives plenty of time to clear doubts in class, records lectures for us to review later, available for help sessions outside class, and he's active on the class GroupMe too!
He brings great energy to each lecture and lightens up the dullness of long lectures. He might be a bit fast, but recorded sessions help.

Manuel is a great math prof. If you're struggling, he is more than happy to help you out. It also helps that he throws in some dad jokes from time to time to lighten the mood. As long as you pay attention and ask for help when you need it, it's an easy grade. I managed to get a high B even while working full time, if that tells you anything.

Grading is basically just exams(80%) but there are the coding assignments as well as homework and quizzes. He's a very approachable person, and very patient with the whole zoom setup. I would recommend him to anyone, as he's very accessible.

He's a good and caring professor but the tests are too difficult and set up in a strange way. Instead of using a lockdown browser with a webcam, you have to have 2 devices set up to be on zoom and taking the exam. Lots of homework. Not an extremely difficult class but not easy either. There are so many assignments and quizzes, lectures are long.

He's a good professor but way too difficult with grading the free response answers on exams. I'm a senior with a 3.8 math and science GPA but for some reason, this class was difficult for me. It's extremely fast-paced and there are so many assignments due at different times that it can get confusing. Wouldn't take again, but is kind and passionate.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Manuel was a great lecturer and made learning easier by having many analogies and jokes to help students understand. He also was very helpful during office hours.

Consider yourself very lucky if you get professor Manuel for Calc II. Calc II on itself is tough but he makes it doable. There is a reasonable amount of different assignments/homework due every week but this keeps you updated with the material for the exam. Lots of help outside of the classroom available as well. Great guy overall.

Professor Manuel was probably my favorite math professor I've had; his lectures are generally easy to follow, even if the concepts can be a little hard to master. His grading is tough but fair, and he is generally just a good person. His office hours are helpful for pretty much all questions. The homework may feel like a lot at first, but its not.

Good professor who cares about the subject however he is a very tough grader when it comes to tests. He does the material really fast in class but has the lectures recorded on canvas. Good professor just make sure to go above and beyond when answering questions on tests.

This class is not very hard, but it can definitely sneak up on you and surprise you with some difficulty. The grading criteria are clear and Professor Manuel is a good lecturer, I just believe that there are some better and some worse professors.

My fav professor fs. If you can, def take him bc he teaches extremely well and is very passionate about the course. as long as you pay attention in class and do the homework, you should be able to get an A in this class. He doesn't give excessive amounts of hw either. All of the hw he gives helps in preparation for the quizzes. Def take him!

Professor Manuel is a master of his craft. Manuel explains topics with such precision to where someone who is horrendous in math will leave the class with a proper understanding of the material. He often makes jokes during lecture and is easily accessible outside of the classroom (understanding too). Highly recommend this professor!

Prof Manuel is amazing im a BIMS major and had to take this class instead of MATH 14o and he was awesome. Hes a very energetic and caring prof he spends time in class going over every detail of the things that need to be done on the notes. His office hours he spends one on one time with every single student and makes sure you understand.
Really organized. Homework is tough. Probably the best at making a math course less boring. Lively during lecture w a sense of humor. Just follow along
Manuel is a very sweet and caring professor. He does do a little fast in class, but he posts the notes done in class as well as a zoom recording. Very particular on free response test questions.

Very funny guy that clearly loves to teach. I personally chose to read the textbook as opposed to listening to him teach. Examples in class don't necessarily help with homework, quizzes, or exams. Good practice exams and feedback for all exams. He is willing to work with you and responds to emails fairly quickly. You must come to lecture for polls.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. Manuel is great. The class is very organized and if you go to lecture, go to recitation, and study well by practicing problems before tests, you'll be set. You can't blowoff this class but if you put in the effort, you can do very well. He cares a lot and is very accessible. He's also very engaging and passionate about math and teaching.

Dr. Manuel is an amazing prof. I'm not a math major and I had to take this course, and he made it so much easier. He cares about his students a lot and takes the time to get to know you. He loves math and has an energetic way of teaching and makes the class doable. Highly recommend taking him!
Mr.Manuel was a great teacher, his lectures were very entertaining and not boring at all. He really does go out of his way to explain the material and make sure you understand.

Prof. Manuel is one of the best math professors out there. He genuinely cares about his students and puts a lot of effort into the course. He is also just a very fun guy, as his personality makes math lectures much more enjoyable than they would with most other profs. Absolutely take him if you can
Take stats instead of MATH 148! Calc 1 was a breeze, but this class is terrible. Examples done in the notes don't help you with homework. Basically impossible to solve without going to office hours.

Prof. Manuel is amazing! He is always ready to help us in the class GroupMe! There are quizzes weekly but they are short and easy if you pay attention! He tries to make classes enjoyable and takes his time to make sure his students understand what he is teaching!

I do not have the best math background, but I've always enjoyed math. I am sure there are better and easier out there, but there are for SURE harder and worse as well. He is caring and pretty accessible out of class. He makes jokes but goes somewhat fast. There are "checkpoints" every class period, so DO NOT SKIP. Overall, he is pretty good!

As someone who took Calculus in high school, this class was very easy and I am confused on why I was required to take it despite having Calculus credit. He is pretty much always available if you need extra help which is nice. If you are proficient in math, I would not recommend attending lectures because you are not going to learn much. Easy A.

OMG Prof Manuel is amazing. His lectures are funny and he's available almost 24/7 in the class GroupMe. He's SUPER organized and you always know EXACTLY what's going to happen over the semester if you read the syllabus. There are quizzes every class but they're super short and easy to ace if you paid attention. If you need a math credit, take him!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Prof. Manuel is one of the best math teachers I've ever had. He explains the material so well, and it honestly made class fly by. There is a lot of homework, but it genuinely helps you learn, and if you do it, you'll be very prepared. He's super fun and as someone who usually doesn't like math: I would retake this class again in a heartbeat.

Dr. Manuel is a hilarious professor, but if you don't understand the material in class, good luck getting him to fully explain issues. There is a lot of outside-of-class work, but it really helps you learn the material. Excellent math professor to take if you're a quick learner and already proficient in math.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Mr. Manuel is hands down the best math teacher/professor I've had. EVER. He is super clear in how the class is structured and what is expected. Attendance isn't mandatory but you had a ton of in class quizzes and assignments that if you missed you won't do well in the class. But these assignments really prep you for the tests. TAKE HIM HE'S GREAT!!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Professor Manuel is a nice and caring person, and he is helpful. There are prep assignments, video quizzes, and checkpoints every class period. And once a week, an in-class-quiz. Also, there is homework due every wednesday. His exams are a little difficult, and he goes really fast in class, it gets kind of confusing. There are easier profs to take.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Manuel was so funny and helpful. He genuinely cares about his students and pushes them to achieve in the classroom as well as out of it. Though the material can be hard at times, his lessons were clear- cut and well organized. The only thing I did not like was the amount of outside homework and teaching yourself. Other than that loved!!

One of the best math teachers I have had. The class has weekly HW, quizzes, and participation questions in class (does drop some). 4 exams. Engages the class and you can tell he cares. Highly recommend

Professor Manuel is so sweet and he genuinely cares but he moves at such a fast pace in class. Hes very easy to access and cares about how you do in the class but hell randomly stop teaching to do checkpoint quizzes or pause class for prep assignments which made it hard to get back on track and keep up with him.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Mr. Manuel is one of my favorite math professors I've ever had. His lectures are entertaining and he tries to make math fun for everyone. The content isn't super hard, almost more of a review of what we learned in High school. He is very good at going through every step possible and he always allows times for questions in class. Take him if you can

He is nice but don't take him. He overloads you with work and expects you to come in knowing all of the information he has yet to teach. He speeds through the notes and does not explain himself well so everyone is always confused and on top of that he assigns hours worth of homework weekly. Office hours are no help either.

Dr. Manuel is an excellent professor. He is very friendly, very knowledgeable, very patient with questions, and very organized. I took Dr. Manuel for Diff Eq (MATH308) in a 5-week summer course and he was the best prof I could have had for that combo. The class is tough, but Dr. Manuel wants you to do well in it and he was as available as he can be
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Manuel is the epitome of what a math teacher should be. He is always open to questions and is very accessible outside for class. The only difficult part about the course is making sense of the textbook, but the lectures usually clear up any confusion. Make sure to do lots of practice before the exams and this class should be an easy A.

One of the most organized professors in the math department. Notes in class were very clear and the homework (while it took a long time to complete) was straightforward. Exams were not bad at all, although the final is a little more difficult than the other two exams. Go to office hours, he is really nice and explains the material well.

Professor Manuel is a solid choice for Differential Equation if you are looking to take it. His course is well organized and he truly cares for his student to succeed. I wasn't really a fan of the prep assignments that he made us do but it was basically free points to get. Overall, I would definitely recommend taking him for Differential Equation.
His class is very straight forward and his lectures are very enjoyable. I took Calc 1-3 at Blinn and honestly he made transitioning into Math at A&M very easy.

David Manuel is a SOLID math professor. Class is amazingly well organized and he always has a smile on his face and cares a lot about his students. Reasonable exams, crystal clear lectures, good office hours, and amazing notes. Take him and you will actually learn differential equations instead of studying to forget like most other profs.
Dr. Manuel made differential equations very enjoyable. Prepare to do a lot of studying.

Is it was very easy to engage myself in the course since Dr. Manuel organized the entire course extremely well. I've never had a college professor who organized their class as well as Dr. Manuel's. To the point where I saw the contrast between this class and my other classes in terms of organization and engagement. He makes this class easier.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Fair prof, and thats good enough for me. Its just this class has a bunch of useless hw. Prep assignments are the most pointless thing, you do this thing before every class and its worth 5% of total grade. There are quite a few things to track but he makes it pretty easy. I think the prof make this class easier. Also his lecture notes are too easy

The course organization was amazing. Quizzes, homework, lecture examples, and computer assignments prepared me well for the tests. There was a lot of help available through office hours and professor Manuel is easy to approach for help. And, for those willing to prepare ahead of time, prep-assignments made concepts much easier to understand.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: THIS MAN IS AMAZING! I feel like I sit through a lot of math lectures and never understand what just happened but every time he taught I understood every step. The only thing I disliked was that he didn't have a formal test review so you had to make your own. Other than that he is incredible and he is willing to help. (ps: he does drop hw grades)
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I took him for my biology calc credit after taking ap ab calc in high school. He explains calculus to where it actually make sense and connects a lot ideas. Recitation is with a TA and has weekly quizzes. Not a super demanding class if you get the concepts in class and study for exams. 3 exams plus the final replaces your lowest exam grade.

Dr Manuel goes through the sections at lightning speed. We are 3 sections (of the book) ahead of all of the other profs. He assigns 20+ hrs of homework every week & adds on a take home quiz or python assignment. His lectures on each section usually have only 1 example which makes the homework impossible to do. He also gives very hard homework
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: The class' content is easy to begin with but he does at least give everyone a chance to pass and I suck at math. Dropped lowest exam grade and then provided assignment that gave 12 points added to 2nd lowerst exam. And the whole time, the exams were just re-used homework questions so we were exposed to exam material without knowing it. Make T-notes

I wasn't prepared for this calc class. Prof expected us to know a lot more than people who had already taken AP Calc knew. I would go to all of his office hours and I never learned from him. I feel like I didn't learn anything in that class except how to copy his notes.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He was a great professor and alawys willing to help outside of class (even helped with a math problem for another class when I randomly walked by). The exams were pretty identical to what was done on the homework, even one exam having every question from the homeworks. It's math and not everyone's that great but he made it easier and more bearable.

I came into calculus 1 with no background in calculus, along with a weak foundation in math altogether. He is a great teacher who cares about his students and Im so thankful I got him as a professor. I do recommend getting private tutoring or going to Evans free tutoring in the library for help because the was NOT an easy class.

I love Professor Manuel. He is funny, caring and you can tell he loves math. He never tries to trick you on test either - it's all be seen in either the homework or notes. There was even one test that a lot of people bombed and he offered us a extra credit assignment. People thought he was hard, but honestly, put in a little work and the A is yours

Prof Manuel is a good guy, and he's available outside of class for office hours. The horrible thing about this class is that there are 3 or 4 online homeworks due every Monday night, but class notes do not help with the homework AT ALL! Overall he's a fine prof, but be ready to use the internet and teach yourself every single thing on the homework

Dr. Manuel is the best. He makes lectures interesting and breaks it down slowly so everyone can understand. He has office hours and he will help you w/ quizzes if you come in to see him. Tests are just like the homework and class examples. He is hilarious and makes the best jokes, so even math is interesting. Drops a bunch of grades too.
reviews.ratingTags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I ended up having to qdrop this class. It was so frustrating trying to teach myself the material for exams. I did all of the homework, attended lectures, went to the week in reviews, watched supplemental videos,&even went straight to him for help. He seems nice&you can tell he tries, but he moves quickly through material & doesn't explain anything.

Prof Manuel was an awesome prof, who offers lots of extra help outside of class: Week in Reviews and office hours. I highly recommend going to both, for help understanding homework problems, as well as working the Week in Reviews in order to study for Exams! Getting an A in this class is definitely attainable - go to class and put in the work!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: I am absolutely TERRIBLE at math. I barely hung onto a C but I dont have anything bad to say about Professor Manuel. He is funny & very explanatory in his lectures. With any other prof I would have failed this class miserably. The only negative thing I have to say is that the online HW & in class tests are way harder than his in class examples.

Actually made calculus a breeze! He is so clear in what he is saying and will make sure everyone is understanding throughout the lecture. This class is an easy A if you do the homework and regularly attend his office hours. You really will get the grade that you deserve.

David Manuel is a professor who is very passionate about what he teaches. Exams are extremely difficult, and drag your grade down a lot. I havent shown up to any of the lectures and Im gripping onto a C, even though all my other grades are high As. Use his week in review sessions!

reviews.comment: A math class at TAMU is not recommended but Dr. Manuel made it doable. He is easy to follow along with in lectures. He is very helpful outside of class and always fair. reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Great prof! A little goofy, as you may expect from someome so passionate about math, but it makes his class interesting! His class definitley isnt easy, and you have to study, but he is the best prof to help you do well.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Hard tests. You NEED to study, I cannot stress this enough. He didn't give us homework, just recommended problems from random supplements you couldn't find in the bookstore. reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Manuel is an awesome prof! He cares about his students and what he's teaching and does a great job explaining the material. There is a good amount of online HW. I'm really awful at math but I went to a help session/office hours once every couple of weeks and was able to pull off an A. I highly recommend this professor, he's very funny too

Nice prof who loves math. Easy to follow lectures and even better understanding opportunities during office hours. He remembers faces and cares about his students. On exams, there are extra point questions that ask about random facts. Online homework is easy, there's a practice version if you want extra problems
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Would take again

reviews.comment: TAKE HIM! He actually cares about his students, it is so refreshing. He reminds you of any assignments/ tests/ extra credit opportunities. GO TO HIS OFFICE HOURS!!!! reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Good prof during class. You get 3 attempts on each (online) hw problem. He drops a few of the lowest quiz and hw grades. However, he is not very friendly/kind during office hours and help sessions.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Manuel is very caring- he puts in grades quickly, advertises office hours and extra help, and posts all of his notes online. He drops the lowest 3 quiz grades and lowest 5 homeworks and replaces your lowest exam with the final. That being said, the tests are challenging and require effort to get As on- very specific on free response.

Dr. Manuel is a great prof! Highly recommend taking him! He explains things very clearly and is easy to understand. He has a lot of ways to help you outside of class and is very caring about his students. He even drops the lowest few quiz and homework grades so that really helps! Do your homework, ask questions and practice for exams!

Don't take Math 166 if you can take 140/141 just because of the difficulty. However, Dr. Manuel was a hilarious and great teacher for this class, even though it was kinda hard even for me who's usually good at Math. Attend Week-In Reviews and pay attention to lectures and you should be good. Replaces lowest Test grade with your Final which was goat

Dr. Manuel's lectures were funny and easy to understand, and he had a very helpful tutoring session every week. The course material is pretty difficult though, so if you don't have a lot of time to devote to studying for it, I would wait to take it.

Professor Manuel's rating on RatemyProfessor is very accurate. He is a wonderful professor who is extremely willing to help you receive a good grade in his class. Go to office hours and week-in-reviews. This class will take alot of time and effort so if you have a full schedule I would stay away. Homework isn't bad, completed in office hours.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Can genuinely say that Dr. Manuel is one of the best profs at A&M and really cares about the success of his students. He gives you all the resources you need to make an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Manuel is a good teacher, but over explains each lesson to the point where it is confusing! He goes off on tangents sometimes, but if you do the homework and do well on the tests you can pull out an A.
reviews.ratingTags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Well I'm going to start off by saying that I am not a math person at all! So if you have a heavy load of classes plus this class you won't do well. You have to put a lot of work into this class and constantly be going to the tutoring and reviews. He's a great prof but make sure you have the time and dedication for this class.

Great professor! I loved his lectures. The material is not hard, but it is NOT an easy A. If you want an easy A, go take Greg for 141. But if he is full, take this prof! His office hours are so helpful. He rounded me up to an A. There is no curve. Such a great prof!!!And great lectures!
Attend all of the week reviews

reviews.comment: Math 166 is one of the best things you can do! Other than quizzes and exams (4), I rarely went to class and passed with an A. Notes are posted online, so that's a huge plus. If your math skills are not great, go to lectures and week in reviews. Study the homework and notes for exams! During exams, read ALL of the instructions for extra points.

Dr. Manuel is a GREAT prof. With the numerous ways to receive help if needed, there is no excuse to not do well in his class. He explains things in a way that is easy to understand, even if you aren't a math person. Online hw is really easy and quizzes and week in reviews are a good idea of what the test questions will be like.

I hate math - I've never been good at it, but Dr. Manuel is the best prof to take. He explains things very clearly and has numerous outside of class tutoring opportunities. The tests are hard but he gives you a lot of resources to study and the final replaces your lowest test grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: The best professor I have taken so far. Knows the material inside and out. Has numerous help sessions, which he hosts, to help understand the material. Not too much homework. Weekly quizzes and homework assignments. Tests can be difficult but if you put  in time, you'll be fine. Great person and an even better prof.

Knows the material and explains it ok, week in review and tutoring sessions defiantly helped. If your math skills aren't the most decent this course WILL be difficult. reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Good professor and knows what he is talking about. He posts lectures online, you have some short quizzes, 4 tests including the final, and homework due each week. Not hard, but be diligent in your work.

Dr Manuel was a great professor. The course itself wasn't too hard, just lots of calculator strategies to memorize. He's hilarious and makes the class fun. He posts his lecture notes online so attendance isn't mandatory but really helps. Drops lowest homework and quizzes. Overall a really good prof!

If you need Math 141, do not take this class even though it counts as the same credit. It is twice as hard as Math 141 and there are at least 2 if not 3 WebAssign homeworks due each week along with studying for the tests and quizzes. If you do end up in this class, get ready to work.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Blank copies of the notes (try to print them out before class) and completed copies are posted online. Class isn't mandatory, but its easier to understand the material if you hear him explain it you. He makes cheesy but funny jokes throughout class, so its not super boring. Take advantage of his office hours for homework help. Overall, he's great!

This is the best professor to take for MATH166. He cracks lots of jokes in class. The only complaint I ever had was that he takes a while to get back quizzes to you. (A lot of times quizzes weren't available to study off of for the exams.) Exams definitely test whether or not you know the material and require lots of studying.

Best math teacher I have ever had. His lectures were not boring in my opinion. Go to class, pay attention, and watch him work the examples. I would also highly recommend going to his week in reviews, they are very helpful. Wasn't necessarily an easy A, but it's very possible. I just looked at notes and week in reviews and got an A+. Take him!

reviews.comment: Just the normal math teacher. He makes the lectures interesting, but can get boring as he moves slowly through the notes. Just do the homework and extra problems and you'll pass!

reviews.comment: He is very clear in his lessons. He goes through definitions and examples for every section of every unit. There are review sessions nearly every week. There's also homework nearly every week for this class and usually one quiz per week; it isn't hard to get a decent grade in the class. Some of the topics are tricky, but he teaches them well.

Cool professor who cares a lot about give you a chance to get a good grade. Tons of Webassign homework and quizzes or tests nearly every week. Quizzes are semi easy if you study and prepworks are very easy. He drops your lowest 3 quiz grades and homework grades and there is an optional final. He tells a lot of cheesy jokes.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Manuel is a very good professor he is always able to help outside of class. Although he is a really good professor and explains everything well I often found myself watching the clock because time seemed to drag by so slowly in that class.

Very clear teaching methods. Hes a great prof. funny too. He drops quizzes ad homeworks. Go to help sessions and week in reviews though. Hes really funny, so you wont be bored in class. He makes math fun!

Awesome professor! There is no excuse for getting a bad grade with this guy- he offers so many options for extra help and answers even the dumbest questions. Definitely go to class and the week in reviews, and you will for sure make a good grade!

Great professor! Made math understandable. Weekly online homework and quizzes! There are 3 tests and a cumulitive final. You can tell he loves his job, so it makes math somewhat enjoyable. Stay on top of homework and study for quizzes and you'll do great!
He's really amusing in class, and a good math professor if you don't like math. Take him.

Professor Manuel is awesome! He's a great teacher and really cares about the success of his students. He explains everything clearly in his lectures but if it does not make sense, he has tons of opportunities to get additional help. He also drops some of the lowest quiz and homework grades which is nice. By far the best math prof I've ever had!

Professor Manuel was an amazing professor. I took his math course and he did a great job explaining every concept clearly but also made a lot of help resources available if you needed help. His lectures are pretty funny and I would definitely take another math class with him. His tests aren't super hard if you know the material.

Prof. Manuel is one of the best professors that I have had at A&M because he is a clear lecturer, helpful during office hours, and gets papers graded quickly. Tips: If you're going to miss class either tell him ahead of time or attend another session (doing this saved my bacon) and make sure you understand what you missed on old tests/quizzes.

I loved this professor! Theres HW on WebAssign and 4 exams including a comprehensive final. USE HIS OFFICE HOURS! Just go there to do your HW and he will help you. He's such  great professor because he LOVES to teach "the language of math". By far my fav professor!

Professor Manuel really seemed to care about his students and our understanding of the material. His Week-in-Review's and office hours were very helpful for online homework and preparing for tests. Although his lectures are long, he keeps your attention. Professor Manuel is a great math professor!

I love Mr. Manuel. He is such a sweet man and truly cares about his students' success. There are 4 tests and a ton of quizzes and homework to bring your grade up. This class definitely wasn't an easy A, but he is super willing to help if you go into office hours, and there are help sessions every night. He also lowkey rocks the pony tail.

Great professor. Should have gotten an A, but did not take advantage of office hours/week-in review. Tests are not easy, but he provides all notes online to study. He is a great guy, lively, and cracks the occasional joke. Definitely would take again with him.

He clearly cares a lot about his students' well-being and understanding. He's kind and always willing to answer any questions, no matter how specific, broad, or simple. He also offers extra credit in his tests if you read carefully, and he makes himself extremely accessible to students through office hours.

Really cool guy! He is very smart, and sometimes surprises you! But a great over all teacher. Assigns weekly homework and tests are not hard but you need to read carefully! Attending class is important but not necessary, but if you don't show up, good luck understanding the material. Very thorough guy! He really wants you to understand the material
Very condescending, doesn't understand how we might be having trouble.
Makes lecture entertaining, weekly homework and quiz, tests are somewhat challenging but straight from the book. Would definitely recommend
He is a great professor. Really cares about the students. Class participation is manditory for the class, but this also allows for a little extra credit. The online help he gives is pretty good too.

Great professor!! Attendance is not mandatory but he will be more likely to curve your grade at the end of the semester if you have good attendance. He speaks very loudly and keeps your attention. Cares how you do and if you learn! Difficult class, but he is very reasonable and helpful as long as you show up and care about the class!

Great professor, makes everything very clear, his voice is really loud which makes you keep your attention.There are daily clicker quizzes, weekly take home quizzes, and weekly homework. Quizzes are really easy, they are always related to what you just did on the homework. Exams tend to be hard, take notes, make practice problems do to well

Great professor! Can be a little quirky, but he kept everything very organized and offered a ton of additional resources. His methods were a lot like the ones I learned at tutoring, which means they're probably the best way. It's still a difficult class, but he at least shows interest in you doing well.
Great professor. Extremely nice and energetic. Will keep your attention and genuinely wants to help you learn. Excellent prof!

He's a great professor. His jokes are somewhat corny and he has a crazy way of remembering rules, but they grab your attention and make you want to listen. He's fairly straightforward. I would definitely take his class again, very fun guy.
he does communicate very well and he's got a loud voice and lecture with his enthusiasm. Sometimes throw out pop quizs
His voice is very audible in the lecture hall, and he enunciates each word very clearly. The exams are somewhat challenging, but he does teach very well.
